title: Chick wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx="44" cy="30" r="2.5" fill="#ffe066"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="26" ry="24" fill="#ffd93b"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="70" rx="18" ry="16" fill="#ffe97a"/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="46" r="18" fill="#ffd93b"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="48" r="13" fill="#ffe97a"/>

  <circle cx="63" cy="50" r="4" fill="#ff9eb5"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="44" r="3.5" fill="#2a1a40"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="44" r="3.5" fill="#2a1a40"/>
  <circle cx="43.2" cy="42.8" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="59.2" cy="42.8" r="1.3" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- Beak -->
  <polygon points="47,51 53,51 50,57" fill="#ff7a00"/>
  <polygon points="48,51 52,51 50,55" fill="#ffa64d"/>
